You are Worker B. Your job is to inspect the GitHub repository `regs-consult-wet` at `https://github.com/canada-ca/regs-consult-wet` and determine content judgments. Write the results to `/workspace/manual_regs-consult-wet.json` as a JSON object.

Determine the following fields exactly:
- `bilingual`: Read the README (or at least the first few hundred lines). Does it contain meaningful content in both English and French? Look for French words/phrases, French section headers, or a clear French translation. Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
- `readme_clarity`: Read the README. Does it clearly explain what the project is, who it's for, and how to use it? `Poor`/`Fair`/`Good`/`Unknown`.
- `security_policy`: Check for `SECURITY.md` in root, `.github/`, and `docs/`. If not found, write `Missing`. If found, read it. If it contains real responsible disclosure instructions (contact info, how to report, PGP key, etc.), write `Present`. If it exists but is just a placeholder or links without real instructions, write `Incomplete`. Allowed: `Present`/`Incomplete`/`Missing`/`Unknown`.
- `issue_response_quality`: Look at the 5 most recently updated open issues (API `issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc`, filter out PRs). For each, check if anyone other than the original reporter commented within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13). If at least one issue has such a comment, write `Active`. If none, write `Stale`. If there are no open issues, write `No Issues`. Allowed: `Active`/`Stale`/`No Issues`/`Unknown`.
- `release_notes_quality`: Check the Releases page (API `releases` or HTML). If no releases, write `No Releases`. If releases exist, check the latest few. If the description actually explains what changed (e.g., bullet points, changelog), write `Detailed`. If it's just a version number or tag with no description, write `Version-only`. Allowed: `Detailed`/`Version-only`/`No Releases`/`Unknown`.

**Important:**
- Use ONLY the exact allowed values for each column.
- If you cannot determine a value, write exactly `Unknown`.
- Never derive a column from another `Unknown` column.
- Prefer public HTML page scraping over GitHub API where possible to avoid rate limits. If using API, add `sleep 1` between requests.
- Use the Bash tool with curl and grep/head as needed, and write to the JSON file using the Write tool.
- Verify the JSON file is written correctly before finishing.
- Return the exact content of the JSON file you wrote in your final message.

# eRegs Pilot2 project

[](#eregs-pilot2-project)

-   This content is archived - no work on this service since 2018. If you have questions, contact lisa at vation.ca or post an issue. Canada Gazette team at PWGSC has taken on the regulatory consultation project.

Planning and design preparations for second pilot of online regulatory consultations.

Pilot1 MVP: 1st online Gazette 1 consultation with inline commenting on the regulatory proposal and an admin/analysis toolkit for the regulatory team to prepare, receive, analyze and review comment submissions

-   Code base & learning for Pilot1 is in this repository
-   [History, posts, architecture and demo links for Pilot1](/canada-ca/regs-consult-wet/blob/master/Pilot1_history.md)

Site MVP: Policy and design ideas for public display of all comments from Open Regulations Platform

-   [Prototype of eRegulations site - home page](https://vation-ca.github.io/p2protos/p2openregs.html)
-   [Policy prototype with privacy, email confirmation, rules etc.](https://vation-ca.github.io/p2protos/p2form-1-en.html)
-   [Prototype of view public comments for an example consultation](https://vation-ca.github.io/p2protos/p2view-subs-en.html)

## Design decisions with policy implications

[](#design-decisions-with-policy-implications)

-   Commenters can hide their personal name from public view
    -   [Background on decision to hide personal names](/canada-ca/regs-consult-wet/blob/master/Decisions_names.md)
-   Commenters must verify their email address before their submission is accepted
    -   [Background on decision to verify email addresses](/canada-ca/regs-consult-wet/blob/master/Decisions_emails.md)
-   Display comments publicly at the end of consultation period, not during the consultation
    -   [Background on decision to display comments after the consultation period](/canada-ca/regs-consult-wet/blob/master/Decisions_timing.md)
-   Format of display of submissions - by submission and by text section, or just by submission
-   No exceptions to public comment display, all submissions - whether submitted online, by email or by snail mail - are displayed online.
-   No parallel process - all submissions are channelled online - no email submissions will be accepted for the pilot consultation.
